Thought: Looking at the IR spectrum, I don't see any peaks in the typical carbonyl region (1670-1820 cm⁻¹). The highest frequency peaks in the spectrum are around 1608, 1605, 1587, 1584, 1505, and 1501 cm⁻¹, which are more characteristic of C=C bonds in aromatic rings rather than C=O bonds. Since there are no peaks in the carbonyl region, this indicates that the molecule does not contain any C=O groups.
